data.text: Channel: draw Vitality and Harmony tokens every action until contact; at each resolution calculate damage. You gain the same calculated points as life tokens. Inverse option: convert the life gain into point-buy damage.

logic.description: Implemented point-buy damage: one die per emission (Vitality, then Harmony→Will), Σ kept dice ÷10 rounded half up to one enemy in contact, and the caster is healed by the damage actually dealt (healDealt, capped at max life). A failed roll re-emits only that element. The paper inverse option is the default pc behaviour (damage + life). Aura / Aura ∀ widen the hit.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).
No declared target (the engine picks the enemy the cast hurts most within 1) or the right-clicked target is within 1 hex; through an Aura ∀ the reach is the whole view (10).
A declared target must be an enemy (exactly one side is npc_b); without one the engine aims at an enemy itself.
A declared target must still be alive (life > 0); dead units are skipped.

effects.description: Rule 20: one point-buy per emission on the caster stat behind the element going out; this is the total number of d6 the whole cast rolls (6·n nearest the stat, ties to more dice).
Σ of the kept dice (one per element, the highest die of each successful roll) ÷10, rounded half up; a failed roll re-emits only that element (cast status retry).
Life the caster regains: equal to the damage dealt.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_vitality (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
